notes.title: New update 1.4.1!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/b46254c076cf471a199211c9322903cdf609c571.png"]

Hello everyone! 👋



This update contains a few bug fixes (see changelog below)...

But the main objective was to help the speedrun community by integrating code they can use to run an “autosplitter” that automatically controls their time counter in LiveSplit.



Hopefully, this will enable them to launch runs in the best possible conditions! 🕺✨


📜 Change log 1.4.1
⚡ Added support for LiveSplit autosplitters to help the speedrun community

 🔨 Fixes one shot trigger feedback

🧁 Changed section 3 of puzzle "Through the Jelly" to avoid a weird behaviour with blocks

🏆 Makes the most difficult trophy in levels "Dangerous Games" and "Prickly Passages" a little easier



Enjoy little robots!  



🐻 The Gentle Beasts🦎

notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/318af93124af6ea8314f3ee44e57f3cbda57bf23.png"]

Hi everyone!

Here's a new update to fix a few small issues, the full changelog is just below.



PS: Don't forget that the 60% Summer Sales discount ends tomorrow! 🌞


📜 Changelog 1.3.0
⚙️ Add an option to disable screen shake in video settings

🚥 Suppression of chromatic aberration and other CRT effects when the “Glow effects” parameter is deactivated

💥 Fix a crash when a character dies while being sucked into the pipe at the end of the level in online mode

🤯  Correction of a crash when a sound effect is triggered when the level should be completely finished

🔦 Fix a bug preventing power lines from being triggered when the remote peer triggers a hammer-bumper or thermometer

🎥 Addition of a small camera zoom at the end of the “Ice Drilling” level to make it easier to read

🧩 Modify section 3 of the “Through the Jelly” level to make it less frustrating

📎 Remove a few slopes from the ceiling on the top level to prevent clipping

🏆 Make the most difficult trophy on the “Fun & Traps” level a little easier

 

Have a great summer little robots!  



🐻 The Gentle Beasts🦎

notes.title: Demo update 0.17.0!
notes.notes:
🏆 Pimp My Bot + Diamond Trophy

Another update for the demo, and not the least!
In fact, it's the biggest update since the demo's launch.

🛠️ The "Pimp My Bot" garage opens its doors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/71a89f5ae8e4d19b81dae4861233ead0cfb309d6.png
Here you can spend your screws to buy splendid hats.
It's designed as a level, so you can visit it as you like, and maybe even discover some secrets?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/a1395ddc6d6031aeaa7c14e5863db6317d17e2ef.png
It's also an opportunity to learn more about the game, and get tips from the mechanic.

💎 New Diamond Trophy

If you like challenges, this is the trophy for you!
But be warned, it's much harder to get than the gold trophy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/c385ceee0ade857e60729d874c7caa0d947d8160.png
You don't need to unlock any of the diamond trophies to complete 100% of the game, and this trophy is only visible at the end of the level if you obtain it. 

Will you be mad enough to reach 110%? 😈

💥 Improved Dash

To improve the understanding of dash and what it entails in the game, we've made several important changes: 


 Added a dynamic hit counter when a character breaks blocks
 Added a visual on the character and a sound effect when the combo fails (block destroyed too slowly)
 There are now two different tutorial levels for learning dash. One for learning the basic principle, 3 blocks broken quickly gives a dash that lets you go fast. The second level teaches you how to use your dash to break blocks, even those not of your own type
 New speed level added between these two tutorial levels, allowing you to practice your dash before learning the subtleties in the next level
 Sound effects changed for combo hits


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/bd762a136a8d2b4130a3b362ae809d1fc3c70dd4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/61143a34af63d5d11ecb529a9792fee9fb61bb2f.png
🏆 Completion
From now on, when you return to the world map after completing a level, an animation is played to confirm the trophies you've just unlocked. In addition to this, the complete list of your trophies is displayed, making your progression through the levels clearer.


👉 Many thanks for your support, we hope you enjoy this update!  💙


-------------------------------------------------------

🔴 Breaking Changes

 New time attack level added at the start of the game
 Add a tuto section to enforce comprehension on the dash mecanic
 Add tuto as a part of the progression
 World map revamped to add the two new levels + add more screws around to be able to buy the hats

🎯 New Features

 New feedbacks when breaking blocks & accumulating combo points
 New feedback on failed combos
 Add the Garage: the game's shop for cosmetics
 Add diamond trophies (Hidden trophies, even harder than gold ones)
 Add a completion hint in the WorldMap to help players to keep track of their progress
 Add secret passages in puzzle levels to help players discover the mecanic before getting into a time attack level
 Add a feedback when a trophy is newly obtained in the world map on the level's entry

🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fix being able to collect screw during level transitions
 Fix camera & button physics bugs when playing with a low fps count
 Fix a bug that lock you in the score menu after mapping the inputs
 Fix the game crashing when spaming the button to load/overwrite a save

🛠️ Other Changes

 Revamp level 4 to make it shorter and less frustrating
 Little changes in level 1 to make it different from the level 0 added before
 Make jump arrow graffiti broader
 Make camera anticipation even bigger to help players see what is coming
 Remove the transparent fog on top of levels (For performance reasons & to help video encoder make better videos of the game)

The demo continues to improve with this speed-oriented update!
Doors now open much quicker, allowing you to go even faster through the levels.
We've also taken the opportunity to adjust the trophies times on levels 3-4-5, making them harder to obtain.

Are you up for the challenge? 🔥

 Doors now open much faster, to make progress through the level more enjoyable and quicker
 Change of tophies timer for level 3-4-5
 Level design changes in levels 4-5 to make it even more synchronized between players

🛠️ Other changes

 Fixed the display of the "retry level" bloc, which was sometimes centered in puzzle levels.
 Fixed broken navigation in the sound menu when one of the settings was set to zero.

notes.title: Demo update 0.12.7!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

First update of the demo, but there's more to come!
We intend to make the demo closer and closer to the final rendering of the game.

Thank you very much for your various feedbacks, which are gradually helping us to improve the game! 💙

🎯 Important changes

 French translation added
 Corrected dash behavior so that it no longer jams in wall corners
 Gold trophies are now slightly more difficult in levels Time Attack 4 and 5
 Correction of a bug that prevented jumping if the two characters were too close to each other
 Correction of a bug around SAS when two players entered at the same time
 Fixed epileptic mode


🛠️ Other changes


 Added sound effects for certain interfaces and camera movements in the world map 
 Correction of a possible soft lock in time attack 2 level
 More visible secret passages in some levels
 Revised level design for levels 4 and 5, with a view to clarifying timing for two players 
 Correction of bouncing platform effect zones on level time attack 5
 Correction of the room with the button in level 3, making the pipe entrance for Stonks more legible
 Correction of the level design in sections 3 and 4 of the "Pipes and buttons" puzzle level
 Corrected the text in the screen where new powers are learned, so that it doesn't protrude from the screens.

notes.title: Patchnote for demo v0.9.54 bugfix update
notes.notes:
Hotfix Update fixing a handful of bugs and issues:

- Restarting a level now correctly reset all datas
- Fix a bug where the boss wouldn't use its missiles
- Fix a soft lock in level4 right after the two successive doors
- Keep the camera dezoomed in teleporters level for more visibility
- Fix time counter not being restarted when trying a level
- Fix progression not being cleared when going back to the screen title
- Fix collectables not being correctly loaded from the save
